payload.chatInput: What should I know about Extension hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit from PMT?

response.answer:
The extension hose you’re asking about is an accessory for the AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit (Arctic Ice Clear system), not a TENS unit itself.

Key details from Pain Management Technologies (PMT):

1) Standard Extension Hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit
- Product name: Extension hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit
- Product code: CTU2CHOSE
- Compatibility: Coolman, Leonns, Arctic Ice Clear, Oasis Space
- Length: 5' (5-foot extension)
- Couplings: Leak-proof couplings included
- Description: Extension hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit
- Specifications: Length (cm): 1, Width (cm): 1, Height (cm): 1, Model: Extension Hose

2) Extension Hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit for Back Pad
- Product name: Extension hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit for back pad
- Product code: CTU2CHOSEEXT
- Compatibility: Coolman, Leonns, Arctic Ice Clear, Oasis Space
- Length: 5' (5-foot extension)
- Couplings: Leak-proof couplings included
- Description: Extension hose for AIS Clear Cold Therapy Unit
- Specifications: Product Weight (lbs): 1, Model: Extension Hose

How it fits into your system:
- These extension hoses are designed for the AIS Clear / Arctic Ice Clear cold therapy machines, which circulate cold water through a therapy pad.
- They simply add length between the cooler unit and the pad, using leak‑proof couplings, which can make positioning the cooler easier (for example, placing it on the floor or a side table while the pad is on your knee, shoulder, or back).

If you are also using a TENS unit, that is a separate electrotherapy device and is not connected through this hose. The extension hose is strictly for the cold-water circulation part of your therapy system.

response.answer:
Mobi Cushions, including the MobiCushion-L, fall under PMT’s general warranty policy for “Mobi Cushions, Powered seat lift devices, Powered Chairs, Thermacycle, and Hot/cold therapy units,” which is:

- Warranty length: 6-month warranty on the unit (the cushion system) and pad.
- Type of coverage: Warranty is for replacement of like items only. If the exact model is no longer stocked, PMT will upgrade you to a like model.
- Outdated technology: If the item is no longer available on the common market as a new product, it is not covered by warranty.
- Accessories: Warranty policy does not include accessories supplied with the device (for example, lead wires, battery, and carrying case). These are considered non‑covered under the main device warranty.
- Consumables/hygienic items: Not covered under warranty.
- Shipping: Shipping is excluded from warranty coverage and will be assessed on any replacement.
- Claims process: Pictures and details of defects need to be provided. Issues outside of product defects will be considered non‑covered.

Applied specifically to the MobiCushion-L battery: the battery is treated as an accessory and is not covered under the standard warranty, even though the cushion unit itself has a 6‑month warranty. For any specific battery concerns or exceptions, you would need to contact PMT directly with photos and details of the issue.

source.title: The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability - Paintechnology.com
source.heading: The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability
source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Water Therapy Systems 
 The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability

 THERAPEUTIC COLD WATER: The Arctic Ice cold therapy machine uses a continuous flow of cold water to provide reduction of swelling and inflammation for those with a disability

 PORTABLE AND QUIET: Designed for easy portability and storage, this compact ice therapy system has a quiet motor for use in the home or hospital.

 DIGITAL CONTROLS: The built-in LCD screen and adjustable settings give you an easy way to control the treatment time and motor intensity as well as monitor water temperature. Convenient easy to read controls are at your fingertips.

 EASY TO ADD ICE: The insulated walls of the AIS allow you to see the fill line easily as well as monitor the ice level in your machine. You'll know right away when it's time to refill the unit to keep the cool flowing.

 Back PAD: Included with your Ice Machine is a Back therapy pad which can be utilized for coverage of the back or large body area. The flexible pad and device have insulated tubing to keep temps cooler longer.

 PRODUCT CODE: AISBACK

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 The Arctic Ice is an ice therapy machine with a clear, insulated cooler basin and tubing, digital controls, and a multi-use therapy pad. The AIS has the ability to control the length of treatment time, up to 30 minutes, and adjust the intensity of the pressure by Liters Per Minute (LPM). The temperature monitor and the ability to see through to the ice levels means you always have your cryo treatment in the correct range. 

Includes: Back cold therapy pack X1 Insulated circulating water tube X1 Elastic bandages X3 DC 12V power adapter X1 Nonwoven barrier X1 Product User Manual X1 

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 1

payload.chatInput: Could you summarize PMT's information about The Arctic Ice Classic– Cold Water Therapy Device with Large Back Pad for Treatment of Disability?

response.answer:
Here is a concise summary of PMT’s information on the Arctic Ice Classic cold water therapy device with Large Back Pad (product code: AISBACK):

The Arctic Ice Classic is a cold water therapy machine designed to provide therapeutic cold using a continuous flow of chilled water to help reduce swelling and inflammation for individuals with a disability. It features a compact, portable, and quiet design suitable for home or hospital use.

The unit includes digital controls with a built-in LCD screen, allowing you to adjust treatment time and motor intensity and monitor water temperature. Its clear, insulated cooler basin and tubing make it easy to see the fill line and keep track of ice levels so you know when to refill. 

This version comes with a Large Back Pad intended for coverage of the back or other large body areas. The flexible therapy pad and insulated tubing help keep temperatures cooler for longer during treatment.

Note: This is a cold water therapy device, not a TENS (electrical nerve stimulation) unit, and it does not use electrodes.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices • Neuropathy Stimulator 
 NERVESPA SILVER CONDUCTIVE GLOVE - HAND GARMENT SYSTEM INCLUDES DEVICE

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NERVESPA SILVER CONDUCTIVE GLOVE - HAND GARMENT SYSTEM INCLUDES DEVICE

 Same technical specs as the Nerve Spa foot bath  
 Foot garment system is lightweight and highly portable        
 Touch screen device
 Built-in Microprocessor 
 7.83Hz, 80Hz, Symmetrical Biphasic Square, and Monophasic Waveform
 Reinforced lead wires
 Includes 1 Pair of Gloves
 FDA Registered
 Includes 24oz of conductive Spray

CONTACT FOR PRICING

 PRODUCT CODE: NSGG10

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

The Nerve Spa Pro is an Advanced Nerve and Neuropathy stimulator that utilizes a proprietary hybrid of electrotherapy including enhanced micro-current, galvanic, and TENS formulated into a proprietary specification—coupled with a monophasic waveform to target pain associated with early-onset peripheral neuropathy, as well other nerve-based pain conditions in the hands and feet.

 Circumferential Nerve Stimulation Treatment

 Surrounds the feet with a soothing and uniform level of current that relieves pain.

 Damaged Nerve Repair

 Increases the body's blood circulation, relaxes inflamed nerves, and works on a cellular level to stimulate the body's own healing mechanisms and repair damaged nerves.

 60-90-Day, Drug-Free Treatment to Reduce Pain

 Using the Nerve Spa over the course of 60 days or longer achieves an aggregate therapeutic effect that works to reverse and relieve peripheral neuropathy and other nerve-based pain conditions.

Aquatic Electrotherapy Stimulation

tests.fingerprint: KB_KNOWLEDGE|Can you explain the PMT information about Soft-Touch Carbon Electrodes cloth back (tyco gel)?

payload.chatInput: Can you explain the PMT information about Soft-Touch Carbon Electrodes cloth back (tyco gel)?

response.answer:
Soft-Touch Carbon Electrodes with cloth back (Tyco/PMT gel) are reusable, self-adhesive electrodes designed for use with most electrotherapy devices.

Key features and specs (from PMT information):

• Type: Self-adhesive, reusable carbon electrodes with pigtail pin connector  
• Backing: Resilient blue cloth (tricot-style fabric)  
• Gel: High-quality conductive gel (Tyco/PMT gel) for good adhesion and comfort  
• Resistance: Approximately 45 ohms  
• Compatibility: Universal for almost all TENS, EMS, Interferential (IF), and Russian stimulation units that use a standard pin-type connector  
• Reuse: Typically about 10–15 uses per pad (or more, depending on care and usage length)  
• Packaging: Resealable pouch; available as multi-packs (e.g., 2" x 2" squares, 2" rounds, 3" rounds, 6" x 3.3" butterfly)  
• Design details: Oval corners to help reduce edge curl and improve durability; designed to provide good current dispersion and consistent performance.

Care and lifespan tips from PMT:

• Apply pads only to clean, dry skin (no lotions or oils).  
• After use, you can lightly rub a small drop of water on the gel surface to help refresh stickiness.  
• Always return electrodes to the backing sheet and seal them in the air‑tight pouch immediately after use.  
• Replace electrodes when the gel starts to wear down, adhesion decreases, or stimulation feels uneven—typically after about 10–15 uses per pad.

In short, Soft-Touch Carbon Electrodes (cloth back, Tyco/PMT gel) are value-priced, premium-style reusable electrodes designed to be comfortable, durable, and broadly compatible with PMT and most other pin-connector TENS/EMS/IF devices.

PRODUCTS
 Mobility Assistance 
 Toilet Tilt – Heavy-Duty, Adjustable Assist Seat for Seniors at Home or in Medical Settings

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Toilet Tilt – Heavy-Duty, Adjustable Assist Seat for Seniors at Home or in Medical Settings

 ​Smooth Glide Motion: Silent, stepless lifting mechanism ensures gentle and stable elevation for all mobility levels.
 Spacious & Strong Build: Wide seat and armrests, crafted with a high-strength plastic frame to support up to 200 kg.
 Rechargeable Battery: Built-in battery. This Toilet Tilt can be used while plugged in for continuous use or battery-powered (will need to be charged when the battery runs out).
 Custom Comfort & Easy Assembly: The height-adjustable seat features a friendly setup, and additional wheels are available for easy installation.
 Whisper-Quiet Motion: Stepless lift technology with an adjustable height of 0-11”.
 Always Operational: Backup battery guarantees lift function during power outages—no interruptions to safety or routine.
 Easy Setup & Custom Fit: Hassle-free assembly, plus adjustable seat height for personalized comfort.

 PRODUCT CODE: TTLift

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 Elevate your daily routine with this smart electric toilet lift chair, thoughtfully designed to support seniors and individuals with mobility challenges. Its whisper-quiet lift mechanism and wide, ergonomic design offer safe, stable assistance with every use. Equipped with reliable backup battery power, it delivers consistent performance at home or in medical settings. Easy to set up and adjust, this chair blends advanced features with practical comfort to restore independence and confidence.

Designed to promote comfort, safety, and independence, this advanced electric toilet lift chair offers reliable support for seniors and individuals with limited mobility, whether at home or in a healthcare environment. Its stepless lifting mechanism allows for smooth angle adjustments up to 11 inches, making sit-to-stand transitions easier and more comfortable.

With a weight capacity of up to 200 kg (440.92 lbs), the Toilet Tilt accommodates a wide range of users. Its universal design ensures effortless transfers, delivering dependable assistance for those with mobility challenges.

payload.chatInput: I need details on Wireless TENS Unit Stimulator by iTENS. What does PMT say about it?

response.answer:
The Wireless TENS Unit by iTENS is listed in the PMT catalog under Electrotherapy Devices as:

**Product Name:** Wireless TENS Unit by iTENS  
**Category:** Electrotherapy Devices / TENS

From PMT’s perspective, this device is a TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation) unit, designed to provide drug‑free pain relief by sending low‑voltage electrical pulses through electrode pads placed on the skin. Like other TENS units PMT offers, it is used to help manage pain (not cure underlying conditions) by:
- Stimulating the nerves to help block pain signals before they reach the brain.
- Encouraging the release of endorphins, the body’s natural pain relievers.

The wireless iTENS format means the stimulator is integrated with the electrodes instead of using separate lead wires, providing a more portable, cable‑free experience compared with traditional pocket TENS units.

PMT’s general guidance for TENS devices applies here:
- Intended use: Temporary relief of pain associated with conditions such as back pain, arthritis, muscle soreness, joint pain, and similar musculoskeletal discomfort.
- Mechanism: Gentle electrical pulses delivered through skin‑surface electrodes to modify how pain is perceived.
- Role: A non‑drug option for pain management; it does not repair tissue or directly speed healing.

For full technical specifications (modes, intensity ranges, battery type, app/control details, replacement pads, etc.) and usage instructions specific to the Wireless TENS Unit by iTENS, PMT directs users to the main website and resource library:
- Product & catalog browsing: https://paintechnology.com/category  
- Manuals, guides, and videos: https://paintechnology.com/resources

If you tell me what kind of detail you’re most interested in (e.g., modes, battery/charging, pad types and sizes, or app compatibility), I can focus on that next.

source.heading: NerveBeam LED Light Therapy Wrap
source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Light Therapy 
 NerveBeam LED Light Therapy Wrap

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NerveBeam LED Light Therapy Wrap

Clinical Device

Red & Infrared Light Therapy for Pain Relief, Circulation, Tissue Warming, and Muscle Relaxation

 Relieve Pain Designed to relieve minor muscle, joint, and nerve-related pain with red and infrared light therapy.
 Improve Circulation Temporarily increases local blood circulation in targeted treatment areas.
 Elevate Tissue Temperature Delivers heat-oriented light therapy support to warm tissues and promote comfort.
 Relax Muscles & Relieve Stiffness Promotes muscle relaxation, helps reduce tension, and supports range of motion.
 Support Healing Works on a cellular level to support the body’s natural healing processes more efficiently.

 PRODUCT CODE: NBRT175

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Clinical Overview

High-Powered Red and Infrared Light Therapy Designed for Broad-Surface Clinical Use

The NerveBeam LED Light Therapy Wrap is a high-powered red light and infrared light therapy device designed to elevate tissue temperature, temporarily relieve minor muscle and joint pain, and temporarily improve local blood circulation across a broad treatment area.

Red light at 660 nm is positioned for surface-level tissue exposure, while infrared light at 830 nm and 850 nm are intended for surface and deeper thermal support. With flexible straps, broad treatment coverage, and high LED density, the NerveBeam is designed for freeform placement across multiple body regions in both clinic and provider-guided home-use workflows.

Clinical Applications

Versatile for Pain Relief, Circulation Support, Tissue Warming, and Mobility-Oriented Care

 Muscle and joint discomfort – temporary relief for minor muscle and joint pain.
 Circulation support – helps temporarily increase local blood circulation.
 Stiff or tense tissue – heat-oriented support for muscle relaxation and stiffness reduction.
 Nerve discomfort and recovery routines – adjunctive support in broader mobility and recovery workflows.
 Clinic-to-home continuity – broad-surface light therapy for provider-guided follow-through outside the clinic.

Key Focus Areas: Pain relief • Circulation support • Tissue warming • Muscle relaxation • Stiffness reduction

Light Therapy Features

Broad-Surface Coverage with High LED Density and Flexible Placement

 Red & Infrared Light Therapy – combines visible red light at 660 nm with infrared light at 830 nm and 850 nm.
 High-Density LED Power – 600 individual LED diodes with 22,000 mW total output for broad treatment coverage.
 Heat Therapy & Tissue Warming – reaches temperatures over 100 degrees Fahrenheit to help elevate tissue temperature and promote comfort.
 Freeform Body Placement – adjustable straps support flexible placement across upper- and lower-body treatment areas.
 Broad Treatment Area – designed to treat more surface area than narrow point-contact devices.
 Provider-Guided Continuity – appropriate for clinic use and provider-guided home routines.

Clinical Pathways

Designed for Flexible Use Across Pain, Recovery, and Mobility-Oriented Workflows

Pain Relief Support

The NerveBeam may be applied over joints, muscle groups, and other targeted regions to help temporarily relieve minor muscle and joint pain while supporting comfort during broader care plans.

Circulation & Tissue Warming

Infrared heat-oriented light therapy may be used to elevate tissue temperature and temporarily improve local blood circulation in targeted treatment areas, especially where warming and relaxation are desired.

Muscle Relaxation & Stiffness Reduction

The wrap is designed to promote muscle relaxation, reduce tightness, and relieve stiffness, making it a useful adjunct before mobility work, stretching, or recovery-oriented care.

Clinic-to-Home Continuity

With flexible straps and broad-surface coverage, the NerveBeam can be incorporated into provider-guided clinic-to-home routines where ongoing comfort, circulation support, and tissue warming are part of the recommended care pathway.

Note: All use should be determined by the supervising clinician and adapted to the treatment area, patient tolerance, and overall care plan. Follow all device instructions and safety guidance in the user manual.

Technical Specifications

Core Device Specs

 Category
 Specification

 NBRT175

 Device Type
 Flexible LED light therapy wrap for provider-guided clinic and home-use applications.

 Red light at 660 nm plus infrared light at 830 nm and 850 nm.

 Total Power
 22,000 mW total output.

 Thermal Output
 Reaches temperatures over 100 degrees Fahrenheit.

 Placement
 Adjustable straps support use anywhere on the body, including wraps for feet.

 Primary Benefits
 Elevates tissue temperature, temporarily improves local blood circulation, relieves stiffness, promotes muscle relaxation, and relieves pain.

 Regulatory
 FDA registered device.

Review the NerveBeam User Manual for setup, operation, placement, safety guidance, and ongoing use instructions.

 Mobility Assistance 
 Travel Light Powered Wheelchair by MobiJoe, 500W Dual Motor - Lightweight Mobility for Seniors, Foldable and Compact for Easy Travel and Storage. Includes 2 Li-ion Batteries.

 Travel Light Powered Wheelchair by MobiJoe, 500W Dual Motor - Lightweight Mobility for Seniors, Foldable and Compact for Easy Travel and Storage. Includes 2 Li-ion Batteries.

 LIGHTWEIGHT AND COMPACT DESIGN: The MobiJoe is designed to be lightweight and weighs in at just 66 pounds while equipped with two fully charged batteries. The ultra compact, folding design means that you can take the MobiJoe wherever you need it. When folded, the chair can be conveniently stored into any trunk space with ease. Stay mobile with the MobiJoe!

 TRAVEL WITH POWER: Our wheelchair features a powerful dual motor system with shock absorption springs and the ability to travel over 10 miles on a single charge. The quick charging battery returns to full power within 6-8 hours so you can keep travelling with freedom.

 BUILT TO LAST: The MobiJoe Travel Light combines portability with durability. It consists of a tough aluminum alloy frame that is still lightweight and can support over 260 pounds. Our electric wheelchairs utilized an electromagnetic braking system to ensure a long lasting construction.

 EASY CONTROL: Our joystick style controller allows for easy operation with simple controls. The joystick directional controls enable the chair to turn immediately at the user’s discretion in order to safely navigate everyday obstacles. Don’t let any obstacles get in your way of living to the fullest!

 STAY PREPARED: The wheelchair comes packed with a charger, two 24V lithium batteries, a seat cushion and a safety belt. In addition, it can also be equipped with travel bags or extra storage if necessary, with enough carrying capacity to support the extra supplies. Bring everything you need along with you so you can keep moving!

 PRODUCT CODE: MJTL10

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

Firm construction and lightweight frame allow the wheelchair to be folded up and packed away with ease. Travel up to 13 miles on a single battery charge and return to full power within 6-8 hours so you can keep moving the whole day.

response.answer:
Travel Light Powered Wheelchair by MobiJoe (Product Code: MJTL10) is a compact, foldable powered wheelchair designed to be both lightweight and durable, making it suitable for seniors and users who need easy transport and storage.

Key features and information:

• Lightweight and compact design:
- Weighs approximately 66 pounds with both batteries installed.
- Folds into a compact size (about 25.9 in x 14 in x 32.3 in when folded).
- Can be stored in most car trunks for travel.

• Construction and capacity:
- Frame made from tough aluminum alloy.
- Combines portability with durability.
- Carrying capacity up to 265 lbs.

• Motor and power system:
- Dual 250W motors (total 500W), 24V system.
- Equipped with two 24V lithium batteries (24V 10Ah each).
- Can travel up to approximately 11–13 miles on a single full charge.
- Top speed up to about 6 MPH.
- Battery recharges to full in about 6–8 hours.

• Control and maneuverability:
- Joystick-style controller for easy operation.
- Joystick can be positioned on either armrest side.
- Allows immediate turning at the user’s discretion to safely navigate everyday obstacles.
- Includes an electromagnetic braking system to help ensure controlled, reliable stopping.

• Comfort and included items:
- Comes with a seat cushion and a safety belt.
- Includes charger and two 24V lithium batteries.
- Can be equipped with travel bags or extra storage (noted as possible add-ons) to carry personal items.

• Overall use case:
- Intended as a travel-friendly power wheelchair for maintaining mobility, especially for seniors or users who need a portable solution.
- Designed to help users stay mobile over a full day of typical use on a single charge, then recharge overnight.

Dimensions (from PMT data):
- Unfolded size: 38.8 in x 25.9 in x 41.7 in
- Folded size: 25.9 in x 14 in x 32.3 in
- Carrying capacity: 265 lbs
- Engine type: Dual 250W 24V motor
- Battery: 24V 10Ah lithium battery (two included)
- Top speed: 6 MPH
- Max distance: approximately 11–13 miles per charge

If you tell me what you care about most (weight, distance per charge, trunk fit, or controls), I can focus on just that part of the Travel Light for you.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Therapeutic Creams and Gels 
 NERVE TARGET ROLL-ON GEL - Targeted Therapeutic treatment for Damaged Nerves, Intractable Back Pain, Joint Aches and Muscles Spasms. 

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NERVE TARGET ROLL-ON GEL - Targeted Therapeutic treatment for Damaged Nerves, Intractable Back Pain, Joint Aches and Muscles Spasms. 

 SUPPORTS TARGETED COOLING & SENSORY MODULATION
(Menthol + Camphor)

 SUPPORTS LOCAL MICRO-CIRCULATION
(Eucalyptus + Witch Hazel + Arnica)

 PROMOTES RAPID TOPICAL ABSORPTION
(Plant-Based Carrier System)

 PRODUCT CODE: NTROLL

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Nerve Target Roll-On Gel: Science-Led Topical Sensory & Microvascular Support

Localized musculoskeletal discomfort is commonly associated with transient inflammatory mediator signaling, altered peripheral sensory receptor activation, and microvascular circulation shifts.

Nerve Target Roll-On Gel is a clinician-developed topical formulation designed to support sensory receptor modulation and localized circulation using counterirritant compounds and botanical extracts evaluated in controlled human research.*

Formulation Strategy: Convergent Sensory & Circulatory Support

This formulation integrates TRP-channel activators, vasomodulatory botanicals, and antioxidant-rich plant extracts studied for their roles in sensory signaling and localized comfort.

TRP Channel Sensory Modulation

Menthol

Menthol activates TRPM8 receptors and has been evaluated in controlled human trials for topical cooling-mediated analgesic effects.

Camphor

Camphor has been studied for topical counterirritant effects and modulation of peripheral sensory receptors.

Microcirculatory Support

Eucalyptus (Eucalyptus globulus leaf)

Eucalyptus oil has been evaluated in human trials examining anti-inflammatory and topical comfort endpoints.

Arnica

Studied in randomized controlled trials evaluating musculoskeletal comfort.

Botanical Antioxidant Support

Camellia sinensis (Green Tea Leaf)

Evaluated in human research for antioxidant and inflammatory biomarker modulation.

Dosing & Application

Apply to affected area up to 3–4 times daily.
For external use only.

Designed for localized use as part of a comprehensive musculoskeletal support strategy.

Formulation Standards

 Third-party laboratory tested
 No artificial dyes
 Manufactured in the USA in GMP-compliant facilities

Selected Clinical Research Context

The ingredient components within this formulation have been evaluated in controlled human trials examining sensory receptor activation, topical analgesic endpoints, inflammatory biomarker modulation, and musculoskeletal function outcomes.

Menthol (TRPM8 activation)

Galeotti et al., Pain (2002)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12406524/

Camphor

Xu et al., Journal of Neuroscience (2005)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15987771/

Arnica (Topical)

Widrig et al., Rheumatology International (2007)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17318618/

Eucalyptus Oil (Topical)

Jun et al., Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (2013))
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23662106/

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 1

Add ice and the cryo-cool system circulates cold water for up to 5 hours; while the heating system revs up in less than 10 minutes and can give you the desired heat level.

Cryotherapy and Hot Water Treatment System – Water Circulating Device by Aqua Relief (with Universal Pad)

This Aqua Relief system is a hot and cold water therapy unit designed for post-surgical recovery and for treating chronic or acute disabilities.

How it works:
- Quietly circulates hot or cold water through a leak‑free 52" hose into a therapy pad, giving full coverage over the treatment area.
- With ice added, the cold (cryo) mode can circulate chilled water for up to 5 hours.
- The heating system warms up in under 10 minutes and provides the desired heat level.

Universal wrap/pad:
- Universal wrap is 11" x 11" and includes a 3" x 39" Velcro strap.
- Can be used on multiple body areas such as hip, ankle, wrist, shoulder, leg, or elbow.
- Additional pad designs are available separately.

Therapy use:
- Cold (ice) therapy: use cold water to help reduce edema and swelling.
- Heat therapy: low‑level heat can be used for long‑duration treatment in people with disabilities.

Indication for use:
- For use in a hospital setting to treat chronic and acute disabilities.

Key product details:
- Product code: ARSwTPU (universal pad configuration)
- For proper use: always keep water above the fill line.
- Not for commercial/continuous use; pump life expectancy is 1700 hours (per Aqua Relief system guidance in the product family).

 Heat Therapy 
 SnuggleBack - Chair Blanket - Blue Pattern Fleece

 Roll over to zoom in

 SnuggleBack - Chair Blanket - Blue Pattern Fleece

 FAUX FUR – Our premium Faux Fur is super soft and extra thick.  Perfect for the coldest of winter mornings or year round use.
 PATENTED PENDING – One-of-a-kind Chair Blanket that attaches to any Office Chair. Wrap the flaps together to create an easy-in and easy-out convenience.
 SHERPA FUR CHAIR BLANKET - Be cozy in style and warmth with our super soft Sherpa FUR interior material.  Sherpa Fur is a hybrid material that mixes Sherpa and Fleece to create a fur like feel, but with a sherpa like warmth, that heats the body to perfection.  So cuddly you won't want to take it off.
 ECO-FRIENDLY – Say goodbye to the thermostat wars.  Stay warm in the winter, or even in the summer when that office AC is blasting.
 NO RISK HEAT – A safer way to stay warm at the office; No need to use dangerous space heaters anymore.

 PERFECT SIZE - One Size Fits Most.

 MACHINE WASHABLE - Easy to care for: machine wash cold with like colors and air dry.

 PRODUCT CODE: SBCBBLU

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 Black Fur

 Blue Fleece

 Raspberry Fleece

 Black Fleece

 Light Grey Fleece

 DESCRIPTION
 Offices are notoriously cold in the winter and cold in the summer as they blast the AC. Say goodbye to the office temperarature wars and stay cozy warm with this one-of-a-kind chair blanket by SnuggleBack. Our unique shape provides easy to access warmth while you work.

Use in your home office or work office; The SnuggleBack mounts to any chair back to fix into position and create a ready when you are, swaddle of cozy warmth!

Instructions:

1. Attach to chair back by securing the straps in place
2. Drape blanket over armrests
3. Wrap and unwrap as desired.

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 1Color : Blue

response.answer:
Here is the available PMT information on the items you mentioned:

1) iTENS Gen 2 docking station and charging cord
- Product name: The iTENS Gen 2 docking station and charging cord  
- Product code: ITCGRCARD  
- Category: Electrotherapy Supplies  
- Description: Docking station and charging cord for the iTENS Gen 2 device.  
- Specifications:  
  • Product weight: 1 lb  
  • Length: 1 cm

2) Lead wires (general PMT options)

PMT offers several types of lead wires for electrotherapy devices and TENS/EMS electrodes. These are NOT specific to the iTENS Gen 2 (which uses its own charging/docking system), but are common accessories for wired TENS/EMS units:

A) Universal TENS Lead Wires – Premium Grade
- Product name: Universal TENS Lead Wires by PMT, Fits Most All Electrotherapy Devices and TENS/EMS electrodes (Premium Grade)  
- Product code: P-LWT  
- Key features:  
  • Extra strong construction – thicker wire with more copper for durability and higher conduction  
  • Universal fit – standard shielded plastic female right‑angle plug, FDA compliant, fits standard 2 mm pigtail electrode/pad connector  
  • Length: 48 inches  
  • One pair (2 leads) to connect up to 4 electrodes  
- Description: High‑quality premium “Tiger” lead wires with 24 copper strands for long life (often 1–2 years for heavy users). Worn‑out lead wires can cause shocks or jolts; replacing them helps maintain optimal therapy performance. Sold in packs of two (1 pair).  
- Specifications:  
  • Product weight: 1 lb  
  • Size/model: Premium Grade

B) Universal TENS Lead Wires – Standard Grade
- Product name: Universal TENS Lead Wires by PMT, Fits Most All Electrotherapy Devices and TENS/EMS electrodes (Standard Grade)  
- Product code: LWS  
- Key features:  
  • Universal fit – standard shielded plastic female right‑angle plug, FDA compliant  
  • Standard 2 mm pins for pigtail electrode pad connectors  
  • Length: 48 inches  
  • One pair (2 leads) to connect up to 4 electrodes  
- Description: Standard lead wires with 12 copper strands. Typical life for heavy users is about 6–12 months, depending on use. Worn wires may cause shocks or jolts, so periodic replacement supports consistent therapy. Sold in packs of two (1 pair).  
- Specifications:  
  • Product weight: 1 lb  
  • Size/model: Standard Grade

C) Electrotherapy Device Leadwires (Pin‑Type)
- Product name: Electrotherapy device leadwires  
- Product code: ET99090101  
- Connector style: Male pin‑wire connection (long, thin cylinder about 0.4 inches long), compatible with any electrode sold on Healiohealth that accepts this style.  
- Description: Standard lead wires for electrotherapy devices. Typical life is about 1–6 months depending on device settings and usage. Periodic replacement is part of normal upkeep for electrotherapy devices.  
- Specifications:  
  • Product weight: 1 lb  
  • Width: 2 cm  
  • Length: 2 inches  
  • Weight code: G

If you let me know whether you’re using an iTENS Gen 2 (wireless) or a wired TENS unit, I can narrow down exactly which lead wire option applies to your setup.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Garments 
 Premium Electrotherapy Conductive Gloves - for TENS Pain Treatment, Carpal tunnel, Inflammation, Arthritis, Nerve and Joint Pain (1 Pair - Silver Thread – kit INCLUDES Conductive Spray - One Size Fits Most)

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Premium Electrotherapy Conductive Gloves - for TENS Pain Treatment, Carpal tunnel, Inflammation, Arthritis, Nerve and Joint Pain (1 Pair - Silver Thread – kit INCLUDES Conductive Spray - One Size Fits Most)

 USE WITH YOUR EXISTING TENS OR ELECTROTHERAPY DEVICE (compatible with 95% of devices) for treatment of Tarsal Tunnel, Carpal Tunnel, Nerve and Joint Pain, Arthritis, Sports Injuries, Post-op Swelling, Pain Management, Inflammation, etc. Our proprietary products were developed over 10 years in a clinical environment to be effective, easy to use, and reliable. NOTE: An electrotherapy device IS REQUIRED (which produces the electrical current) BUT is NOT included, as is applying CONDUCTIVE MOISTURE.

 TREAT YOUR ENTIRE Hand and Wrist simultaneously, which is not possible with adhesive electrodes alone. Electrode garments, when used with the necessary conductive moisture (spray or gel), provide a more comprehensive, extensive, and uniform treatment. Electrode garments require the use of conductive moisture to facilitate the transmission of your device's healing current to the skin.

 COMPATIBLE with 95% of TENS, EMS and electrotherapy devices (SOLD SEPERATELY), Pain relieving Conductive Spray Included.

 UNIVERSAL One Size Fits Most construction – our Gloves are as light, flexible, and comfortable to wear as ordinary gloves.

 PACKAGE INCLUDES: 1 PAIR  with pigtail lead wire adaptors with instructions. NOTE that all electrode garments REQUIRE THE USE OF CONDUCTIVE SPRAY OR GEL FOR BEST RESULTS. You can use distilled water as well.

 PRODUCT CODE: EGlove

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 Conductive Gloves are woven with a special silver filament to maximize both conductivity and comfort. Commonly recommended by many Physicians and Specialists, conductive gloves are used in conjunction with electrotherapy devices for the treatment and management of various types of pain. When ordered as a kit, gloves come packaged with our Proprietary Conductive Electrode Solution which enhances the conductivity of silver-wire garments and rehydrates adhesive electrode pads. As well, contains menthol and provides pain relief in itself. This spray contains over 60 beneficial trace elements.

Conductive garments are commonly recommended to patients for use in the treatment and management of pain associated with many of the following: Nerve and Joint Pain, Stiffness, Common Aches and Pains, Arthritis, Carpel Tunnel Syndrome, Plantar Fasciitis, Degenerative Joint Disease, Reflex Sympathetic Dystrophy, Sports Injuries, Accidents, Post-Surgery Swelling, Post-Surgery Healing, Foot , Ankle & Lower Leg Abnormalities, Hand, Wrist & Forearm Abnormalities, and many other conditions. Electrotherapy can be performed in the convenience and safety of your own home. It is simple, proven, and often provides almost immediate results. Electrotherapy can prevent the need for powerful and often dangerous medications. Many users report that electrotherapy is relaxing, enjoyable, soothing and energizing. Electrotherapy sessions often dramatically reduce pain and are also known to help improve the quality of sleep after treatment. NOTE: All conductive garments must be used in conjunction with an electrotherapy device, purchased separately, AND CONDUCTIVE SPRAY OR GEL.

 SPECIFICATIONS

payload.chatInput: What should I know about Electrotherapy Glove - one size fits all from PMT?

response.answer:
I don’t have a specific Knowledge Base entry for the “TENS Unit Glove – One Size Fits All” from PMT.

However, based on standard TENS/EMS conductive gloves typically used with PMT-style devices, here’s what you should generally know:

• Purpose: A TENS glove is a conductive fabric glove used as an alternative to standard adhesive electrode pads for treating the hand, fingers, and sometimes part of the wrist/forearm.
• Use with a TENS/EMS unit: The glove connects to your TENS or EMS device via standard lead wires (usually the same snap or pin connectors used for regular electrodes). It does not work on its own; it must be attached to a powered TENS/EMS unit.
• One size fits all: Designed to fit most adult hands using stretchable conductive fabric. It may not be ideal for unusually small or large hands, but it is intended to be flexible and adjustable by nature of the material.
• Typical applications: Hand pain, stiffness, general discomfort, or for people who have trouble keeping small adhesive pads on their fingers or hand. It provides more uniform coverage over the whole hand.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices 
 NerveSpa Shoulder Pro

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NerveSpa Shoulder Pro

Joint & Mobility System

Advanced OA/RA Treatment Device for Shoulder Pain Relief, Function, and Joint Health

 Relieve Pain Helps reduce pain and other symptoms associated with shoulder arthritis, tendonitis, bursitis, and degenerative shoulder conditions.
 Improve Function Supports range of motion, activity tolerance, and improved shoulder function through repeated use.
 Support Joint Health Designed to help maintain overall shoulder joint health and support progressive joint-focused care.
 Promote Circulation Targets the shoulder region to support localized circulation and therapeutic tissue engagement.
 Hybrid Programming Powered by NerveSpa + Jstim programming to support provider-guided shoulder care pathways.
 Provider-Guided Continuity Includes bicep and shoulder pad supply for structured home-use continuity between visits.

 PRODUCT CODE: NSSHLD90

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Clinical Overview

NerveSpa Shoulder Pro

A provider-focused, noninvasive treatment system designed to reduce pain and other symptoms associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, tendonitis, bursitis, and degenerative shoulder conditions, while improving function and supporting long-term shoulder joint health through proprietary hybrid stimulation programming.

NerveSpa Shoulder Pro is a noninvasive treatment system developed for provider-guided care in shoulder pain, joint deterioration, and mobility-related pathways. It combines proprietary NerveSpa programming with Jstim-derived joint stimulation technology in a wearable shoulder format designed for repeated home-use continuity.

The system is built to deliver targeted electrical stimulation across the shoulder joint, surrounding tissue, tendons, ligaments, cartilage, and support structures. Its therapy approach is designed to reduce pain and other symptoms, improve function, support circulation, and promote progressive joint-focused care over time.

In more advanced positioning, Shoulder Pro is designed to help maintain the overall health of the shoulder joint, help prevent deterioration of the joint, and through its hybrid programming architecture, support cartilage-focused care while reinforcing home compliance between visits.

Clinical Applications

Shoulder-Related Treatment and Home Continuity Use Contexts

 Osteoarthritis of the shoulder
 Rheumatoid arthritis of the shoulder
 Tendonitis and bursitis support
 General shoulder pain and function support
 Recovery-oriented care for active individuals
 Adjunctive support alongside regenerative or broader provider-guided care plans
 Home continuity following provider-guided in-clinic plans

Key Focus Areas: OA / RA treatment • Pain relief • Function improvement • Joint health support • Home continuity • Fits small to X-large

Quick Specs

Core System Snapshot

 Product Code
 NSSHLD90

 Primary Use
 Shoulder joint treatment support

 Programming
 NerveSpa + Jstim hybrid

 Fit
 Fits small to X-large, with extender straps needed for XXL–XXXL

Shoulder Pro Features

Provider-Guided Joint Support in a Wearable Shoulder Format

Noninvasive OA / RA and Degenerative Shoulder Treatment

Shoulder Pro is designed as a noninvasive treatment option for shoulder-related symptoms associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, tendonitis, bursitis, and other degenerative shoulder conditions, helping reduce pain and other symptoms while supporting function-oriented care without drug-based intervention.

Built for provider-guided shoulder pain, joint health, and mobility workflows.

Hybrid Programming Architecture

The device combines NerveSpa programming and Jstim-derived joint stimulation concepts in one system, delivering a dual-program structure designed to support comfort, circulation, overall joint health, and deeper joint-focused treatment pathways.

Mode 1: Monophasic spike wave at 7.83 Hz (NerveSpa programming)
Mode 2: Monophasic pulse / high-volt galvanic wave (Jstim programming)

Wearable Joint-Focused Design

The wearable format surrounds the shoulder and helps deliver therapy across the joint region and adjacent support structures, including tissue, tendons, ligaments, cartilage, and surrounding anatomical zones involved in joint stability, deterioration resistance, and mobility.

Intended for repeated one-hour therapy sessions.

Professional Kit Continuity

The standard supply configuration includes bicep pads and shoulder pads to support routine use and consistent protocol adherence. Extension strap options allow broader fit support where needed for longer-term joint care continuity.

Includes 3 packs of bicep pads and 3 packs of shoulder pads.

Clinical Pathways

How Shoulder Pro Fits into Shoulder Preservation and Mobility Support

Shoulder Arthritis Support

Supports pain relief and symptom reduction in osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis pathways affecting the shoulder joint, while helping maintain function and day-to-day shoulder comfort.

Tendon and Bursa Irritation Support

Can be incorporated into provider-guided care plans where tendonitis, bursitis, or repetitive-use inflammation are part of the clinical picture.

Recovery and Function-Oriented Use

Useful within broader recovery plans focused on improved shoulder function, mobility tolerance, and structured home continuity between in-clinic visits.

Joint Preservation Positioning

Positions Shoulder Pro as part of a conservative shoulder preservation workflow designed to help maintain joint health and potentially delay more invasive intervention pathways.

Resources

Included Supply and Support Notes

Included with standard configuration: 3 packs of bicep pads and 3 packs of shoulder pads.

Fit note: Fits small to X-large. Extender straps are needed for XXL–XXXL.

Shoulder Pro is intended for provider-guided use as part of a broader shoulder pain, arthritis, and function-support plan. Stimulation should be adjusted to a very mild sensory level.

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 1

PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices • TENS 
 Ultima 3t Plus TENS (tri-mode w/ timer)

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Ultima 3t Plus TENS (tri-mode w/ timer)

 Twice the battery life of a typical analogue device.
 Package Includes: Device, batteries, lead wires, 1 pack of 4 electrodes, carrying case and users manual.
 Dual channel device with 3 modes of operations 
 Pulse width, pulse amplitude, and timer are all adjustable

 PRODUCT CODE: U3Tplus

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION
 The Ultima 3T TENS - is a dual Channel device with 3 modes of operation (B, N, and M). Its pulse width and pulse frequency are adjustable. It is also equipped with a 30, 60, 90 minute timer, and has a protective cover over the controls.

TENS units nerve stimulator with 3 modes and timer is durable, ergonomic, has always, a potent defense against pain. TENS neuromuscular stimulator can relieve pain and discomfort. This nerve stimulator comes ready-to-use with 1 pack of 4 electordes. Nerve stimulator is a device used to treat chronic pain, and pain associated with active or post- traumatic injury unresponsive to other standard pain therapies.

The electrical nerve stimulation device is applied to the surface of the skin at the site of the pain. Just remove the sleek black neuromuscular stimulator unit from its professional case, insert the battery, apply the electrodes, and plug in the lead wires. Turn on the muscular stimulator unit which has 3 modes(Burst, Normal, Modulation), to adjust the pulse width (how strong the current is) and the frequency (how many times the current is delivered over time) and you can enjoy a pain free day while you take it anywhere you go. TENS neuromuscular therapy stimulates sensory nerves to block pain signals, stimulate endorphin production to help normalize sympathetic function and has a biphasic, low volt current. Neuromuscular stimulator comes with 5 year warranty against mechanical defects.

This type of stimulation is characterized by biphasic, low volt, current and selectable parameters such as pulse rate and pulse width. TENS stimulates sensory nerves to block pain signals, stimulate endorphin production to help normalize sympathetic function.

A prescription from your physician or physical therapist is required for this device.

 Burst:
 7 pulses per burst, 2 bursts per second, 100Hz fixed frequency.

 Modulation Mode:
 Pulse width is automatically varied in a cyclic pattern over an interval of nominally 4.0 Seconds.

 Normal:
 Continuous output with adjustable amplitude, pulse rate, pulse width.

 Timer:
 30 min, 60 min, constant

response.answer:
Pain Management Technologies (PMT) offers several cervical (neck) traction products designed for home use to help stretch and decompress the neck area. Here is a summary of the main traction-related information from PMT:

1. **Premium Pneumatic Cervical Traction Collar (Product Code: CVT2000)**  
- Portable, inflatable neck traction collar for neck pain relief.  
- Anatomically designed to support the neck and head while providing gentle traction.  
- Thin and lightweight; made of soft rubber with soft textile at the top and bottom for comfort.  
- Uses built-in air chambers inflated with an included air pump.  
- The user slowly pumps air to a comfortable stretch level; this traction helps tight neck muscles relax and relieves pressure in joints and nerves.  
- Intended for people with neck tension, including office workers and those with issues like whiplash.

2. **Neck Traction Device by Air Collar – Neck Stretcher – Cervical Traction Device – Neck & Shoulder Pain Relief – Stretcher Collar for Improved Spine Alignment (2nd Gen – Manual)**  
- Designed to encourage improved posture and gently stretch the neck to help reduce pressure on nerves.  
- Can be used for stiff neck, pinched nerve, or sore shoulder muscles, for short daily sessions.  
- Aims to increase flexibility and range of motion with at‑home neck traction.  
- **Fully adjustable:**  
  - Precision knobs on both sides adjust up and down to set traction strength up to 20 lbs of pressure.  
  - A back air‑bladder lifts the cervical spine vertically using air columns, and the user controls the pressure.  
- **Natural realignment:**  
  - By stretching muscles and freeing nerve root tissue, the device is designed to help vertebral discs realign toward the natural ~20‑degree curve of the cervical spine.  
- **Everyday relief focus:**  
  - Regular use is intended to address muscle tension, stiffness, and fatigue that can come from long periods of sitting, standing, or office work.

3. **Neck Traction Device by Air Collar – 2nd Generation with Electric Pump**  
- Same core concept and goals as the manual 2nd Gen Air Collar above (neck tension relief, posture support, stretching, and decompression).  
- Also adjustable with side knobs for traction strength (up to 20 lbs) and a back air‑bladder for vertical lift of the cervical spine.  
- The key difference is the **electric pump**, which automatically inflates to apply traction instead of manual pumping, while still allowing the user to control pressure.

Overall, PMT’s traction products are portable cervical traction solutions that use inflatable air systems and adjustable controls to provide gentle, customizable neck stretching. They are designed for home use to help relieve neck and shoulder tension, support better posture, and promote spinal alignment.

If you’d like, tell me which specific traction product (CVT2000 collar, 2nd Gen manual Air Collar, or 2nd Gen electric Air Collar) you’re most interested in and I can focus just on that device.

- Portable, inflatable neck traction collar for neck pain relief.  
- Anatomically designed to support the neck and head while providing gentle traction.  
- Thin and lightweight; made of soft rubber with soft textile at the top and bottom for comfort.  
- Uses built-in air chambers inflated with an included air pump.  
- The user slowly pumps air to a comfortable stretch level; this traction helps tight neck muscles relax and relieves pressure in joints and nerves.  
- Intended for people with neck tension, including office workers and those with issues like whiplash.

2. **Neck Traction Device by Air Collar – Neck Stretcher – Cervical Traction Device – Neck & Shoulder Pain Relief – Stretcher Collar for Improved Spine Alignment (2nd Gen – Manual)**  
- Designed to encourage improved posture and gently stretch the neck to help reduce pressure on nerves.  
- Can be used for stiff neck, pinched nerve, or sore shoulder muscles, for short daily sessions.  
- Aims to increase flexibility and range of motion with at‑home neck traction.  
- **Fully adjustable:**  
  - Precision knobs on both sides adjust up and down to set traction strength up to 20 lbs of pressure.  
  - A back air‑bladder lifts the cervical spine vertically using air columns, and the user controls the pressure.  
- **Natural realignment:**  
  - By stretching muscles and freeing nerve root tissue, the device is designed to help vertebral discs realign toward the natural ~20‑degree curve of the cervical spine.  
- **Everyday relief focus:**  
  - Regular use is intended to address muscle tension, stiffness, and fatigue that can come from long periods of sitting, standing, or office work.

3. **Neck Traction Device by Air Collar – 2nd Generation with Electric Pump**  
- Same core concept and goals as the manual 2nd Gen Air Collar above (neck tension relief, posture support, stretching, and decompression).  
- Also adjustable with side knobs for traction strength (up to 20 lbs) and a back air‑bladder for vertical lift of the cervical spine.  
- The key difference is the **electric pump**, which automatically inflates to apply traction instead of manual pumping, while still allowing the user to control pressure.

Overall, PMT’s traction products are portable cervical traction solutions that use inflatable air systems and adjustable controls to provide gentle, customizable neck stretching. They are designed for home use to help relieve neck and shoulder tension, support better posture, and promote spinal alignment.

payload.chatInput: What information does PMT provide about Cold Compression?

response.answer:
Pain Management Technologies (PMT) provides several cold therapy (cryotherapy) systems that deliver continuous cold water to a universal therapy pad, with some models also offering air/pressure adjustment. These systems are designed to circulate chilled water from an insulated basin through flexible pads that can be used on multiple body areas such as the knee, shoulder, elbow, and more.

From the available information:

1. **Blue Cube Cold Therapy Machine (PRODUCT CODE: BCold)**  
- Type: Cold therapy machine (Model: Cold only)  
- Function: Uses a continuous flow of cold water to engulf the treatment area.  
- Features:  
  - Clear, insulated cooler basin and tubing  
  - Digital controls  
  - Adjustable treatment time up to 60 minutes  
  - Adjustable intensity of pressure by Liters Per Minute (LPM)  
  - Temperature monitor and clear basin so you can see ice levels and keep cryotherapy in the correct range  
  - Universal flexible pad for knee, shoulder, elbow, and more  
  - Insulated tubing to help keep temperatures cooler longer  
- Included:  
  - Therapy machine with universal pad x1  
  - Elastic stretchy bands x2  
  - DC 12V power adapter x1  
  - Product user manual x1

2. **Arctic Ice Clear (PRODUCT CODE: CTU2-Ckit)**  
- Type: Ice (cold) therapy machine  
- Features:  
  - Clear, insulated cooler basin and tubing  
  - Digital controls  
  - Adjustable treatment time up to 30 minutes  
  - Adjustable intensity of pressure by LPM  
  - Temperature monitor and clear basin to monitor ice levels and help maintain proper cryo range  
  - Universal flexible therapy pad for knee, shoulder, elbow, and more  
  - Insulated circulating water tube  
- Included:  
  - Universal cold therapy pack x1  
  - Insulated circulating water tube x1  
  - Elastic bandages x3  
  - DC 12V power adapter x1  
  - Nonwoven barrier x1  
  - Product user manual x1  
- Spec: Product weight ~1 lb

3. **Polar Sport Mini 5L (CT CODE: PS5L)** and **Polar Sport Mini 12L (PRODUCT CODE: PS12L)**  
- Type: Ice therapy machines (5L and 12L basin sizes)  
- Features (both share the same functional characteristics):  
  - Clear, insulated cooler basin and tubing  
  - Digital controls  
  - Adjustable treatment time up to 30 minutes  
  - Adjustable intensity of the pressure by Liters Per Minute (LPM)  
  - Temperature monitor and visibility of ice level to help keep treatment in the correct cryo range  
  - Universal multi-use therapy pad, flexible and comfortable for knee, shoulder, elbow, and more  
- Included (each size):  
  - Universal cold therapy pack x1  
  - Insulated circulating water tube x1  
  - Elastic bandages x3  
  - DC 12V power adapter x1  
  - Product user manual x1  
- Spec: Product weight ~1 lb; color: blue

Across these systems, PMT emphasizes:
- Continuous-flow cold therapy delivered via water circulation. 
- Clear, insulated basins with temperature monitoring and visible ice levels. 
- Digital control over treatment duration (typically up to 30 or 60 minutes depending on model). 
- Adjustable pressure/intensity using flow rate in Liters Per Minute (LPM). 
- Universal, flexible therapy pads that can be wrapped to various body regions using elastic bands. 

If you’d like details on one specific model (Blue Cube, Arctic Ice Clear, or Polar Sport Mini 5L/12L), tell me which one and I can focus only on that device.

Cervical Traction Device Neck Pain Relief by Theratrac – Wide is a portable cervical traction device designed to gently stretch and support the neck.

Key details:
- Product name: Cervical Traction Device Neck Pain Relief by Theratrac – Wide
- Product code: PCT100-W
- Size: Wide (measure neck circumference to select the correct size; other sizes are Small and Regular)

What it does:
- Unlocks neck muscles: Gently stretches tight or “locked” neck muscles so they can slowly relax, helping misaligned vertebrae return toward their normal supportive position.
- Realigns discs: Uses pneumatic decompression to help vertebral discs realign, reducing pressure on nerve root tissue.
- Pain relief and posture support: With two points of traction, it provides neck traction for pain relief, muscle relaxation and stretching, and posture improvement.

How it works / design:
- Pneumatic traction: Both the neck portion and the headrest section inflate with more than 30 lbs of adjustable pneumatic pressure to create traction in the cervical curve.
- Head and neck cradle: The device has a shaped neck portion and a vertically pneumatic headrest section that cradle the head and neck while traction is applied.
- Easy to use: Inflates and deflates using hand pumps to adjust the amount of traction.
- Portable: Durable, lightweight, and convenient for use at home or on the go.

This description is specific to the Theratrac Wide size version of the cervical traction device. For exact sizing, you would measure your neck circumference to confirm that the Wide size is appropriate.

source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Mobility Assistance 
 Premium Lift Assist Memory Foam Cushion by Seat Boost - Portable Alternative to Lift Chairs, Stand Assist Handicap Mobility Help for 70% Lift Support (Large – lifts 200-340lbs)

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Premium Lift Assist Memory Foam Cushion by Seat Boost - Portable Alternative to Lift Chairs, Stand Assist Handicap Mobility Help for 70% Lift Support (Large – lifts 200-340lbs)

 SEAT ASSIST HELPS MAINTAIN ACTIVE AND INDEPENDENT LIFESTYLE: It’s difficult to have to rely on someone else to help with regular everyday activities like getting up and sitting down, but now you can take some of your independence back. This easy uplift cushion helps you safely get up and sit down, reducing strain on your muscles and helping you conserve energy for more important tasks. It also offers great relief to caregivers.

 70% LIFT ASSISTANCE TO MAINTAIN LEG STRENGTH: No matter what’s been keeping you down, a Seat Boost chair lift cushion can help you back up. Great for assisting older ones who have difficulty standing from a seated position as well as those with arthritis, ALS, Parkinson’s disease, neuromuscular disorders, or those recovering from surgery. It gently lifts only when needed and without pushing you forward.

 EASY TO TAKE WHEREVER YOU GO: You don’t have to sacrifice daily living, your social life, or fun activities because you have trouble getting up. This highly portable cushion lift weighs only 8.5 lbs. and can be taken to other homes while visiting as well as public places like churches, restaurants, and theaters.

 COMFORTABLE AND EASY TO TAKE CARE OF: Comfort is important when you want to sit down and relax. The Seat Boot easy rise cushion is padded with a super comfortable, slightly curved foam cushion that molds to your individual shape. Both the cover and cushion are easily washable. For additional safety, the base uses a non-slip material to prevent it from moving and slipping.

 NO BATTERIES OR ELECTRICITY NEEDED: Never worry about battery life running low or a power outage leaving you stranded, the Seat Boost seat riser cushion is self-powered. Using the help of a hydropneumatic gas spring as a lifting mechanism, the seat assist automatically releases and begins to lift when you start to stand.

 PRODUCT CODE: SB1000-L

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 Small

 Large

 DESCRIPTION
 Don’t give up your freedom and independence because getting up from your chair is difficult. Seat Boost’s lift seats for chairs get you on your feet so that you can do tasks around the house, visit friends or family and easily participate in social activities like going to the movies, church, or out to eat. These cushioned chairlifts are not only for seniors, they are also great for assisting anyone who is recovering from surgery or dealing with arthritis, ALS, Parkinson’s disease, degenerative joint disease, other neuromuscular disorders, and joint or muscle strain. It not only gives the user freedom to move, it also helps relieve caregivers from lifting or worrying. Conveniently, the Seat Boost cushioned lift assist doesn’t need batteries or electricity to run but when properly adjusted according to your weight, uses a hydropneumatic gas spring to gently and safely lift as far as 8-11 inches as soon as you start to stand. This self-powered feature makes it easy to take on the go without worrying about finding a power source. The seat is adjustable and suited for 200 lbs-340lbs. **NOTE: THIS IS MEANT TO PROVIDE 70% SUPPORT TO THOSE WITHIN THE SPECIFIED WEIGHT RANGE. 70% SUPPORT MEANS THAT 30% SUPPORT WILL BE REQUIRED BY THE USER TO MAINTAIN LEG STRENGTH**

 SPECIFICATIONS

 Product Weight (lbs) : 9.0625Length (cm) : 53Width (cm) : 13Height (cm) : 48HCPCS Code : E0629Weight Range : 195-350 lb/88-159 kg

response.answer:
The Premium Lift Assist Memory Foam Cushion by Seat Boost from PMT is a portable sit-to-stand aid designed as an alternative to bulky lift chairs.

Key points to know:

• Purpose & use: 
  - Helps you safely get up from and sit down in a chair, reducing strain on your muscles.
  - Supports an active, more independent lifestyle for people who have difficulty standing from a seated position.
  - Provides relief for caregivers by making transfers and stand-ups easier.

• Who it’s for:
  - Older adults or anyone who struggles to rise from a chair.
  - People with arthritis, ALS, Parkinson’s disease, neuromuscular disorders, or those recovering from surgery.

• Lift assistance:
  - Provides 70% lift assistance so you still use your leg muscles and maintain strength.
  - It gently lifts only when needed and does **not** push you forward.

• Comfort & construction:
  - Padded with a super comfortable, slightly curved memory foam cushion that molds to your body.
  - Designed for comfort when sitting and for repeated use throughout the day.

• Portability:
  - Highly portable; weighs about 8.5 lbs.
  - Can be taken to other homes and public places such as churches, restaurants, and theaters.

• Maintenance & safety:
  - Cover and cushion are easily washable.
  - Base uses a non-slip material to help prevent sliding on the chair.

• Power & mechanism:
  - Self-powered; **no batteries or electricity needed**.
  - Uses a hydropneumatic gas spring lifting mechanism that automatically begins to lift when you start to stand.

• Size/variants:
  - Comes in different sizes (e.g., Small and Large) with different user weight ranges (such as 95–220 lbs for Small and 200–340 lbs for Large). Choosing the correct size is important so the lift support matches the user’s weight.

If you’d like, tell me the user’s approximate weight and I can help you match the appropriate Seat Boost cushion size from these options.

response.answer:
Cold water therapy pads used with cryotherapy units are different from standard TENS electrodes. They circulate cold (or hot) water through a pad to provide temperature-based therapy rather than electrical stimulation.

From PMT’s information:

1. **Cold Water Therapy Pads (Cryotherapy Pads)**
- These are water therapy *pads/wraps*, not gel TENS electrodes.
- Designed for use with hot or cold water therapy units (cryotherapy machines).
- Provide **continuous water flow** through the pad to cover and treat the target area.
- Useful for post-surgical recovery, sports injuries, swelling, and other acute or chronic conditions where cold therapy is appropriate.
- Built as **hospital-grade** accessories for professional-level treatment at home.

2. **Compatibility & Couplings (Versatile Fit Concept)**
PMT offers coupling converters so their water therapy pads can work with many different cryotherapy machines:

- **Water Therapy Coupling Converter (Product Code: TP2020-CC)**
  - Converts many existing circulating water therapy systems to be compatible with **PMT brand water therapy pads**.
  - Used with hot or cold units.
  - Quick-connect/disconnect design to help **reduce leaks** and make attachment easier.
  - Lets you replace old or ill-fitting connectors so PMT pads can be used on systems that were not originally designed for them.

- **Cold Water Therapy Couplings for Arctic Ice Clear / Arctic Medical / Coolman / Water Therapy Units (Product Code: TP2020-CC-White)**
  - A set of replacement couplings to convert or refresh existing systems.
  - Also uses quick-connect/disconnect fittings to improve seal and reduce leaks.

3. **Example PMT Water Therapy Pads (for Cryotherapy Units)**
These are typical PMT cold water therapy pads that show how the “versatile fit” works with different systems via couplers:

- **Universal Cold Water Therapy Pad (Product Code: TPU-New)**
  - **Compatible with:** Arctic Ice Clear directly.
  - **Not compatible with:** Arctic Ice Classic, ARS, Polar Vortex, Polar Sport **unless** a coupling converter is used.
  - Provides **continuous flow** to circumferentially cover the body area being treated.
  - Includes **leak-proof quick connect/disconnect** couplings for easier swapping between pad types and pausing treatments.
  - Includes a **strap** to secure the pad to the area of need.
  - Designed for use with **hot or cold** water therapy units.

- **Face Cold Water Therapy Pad (Product Code: FC)**
  - **Compatible with:** Arctic Ice Classic, ARS, Polar Vortex, Polar Sport directly.
  - **Requires coupling converter** for Arctic Ice Clear and certain other manufacturers.
  - Also provides continuous flow, leak-proof connections, and includes a strap.

4. **Important Distinction vs. TENS Electrodes**
- These cold water therapy pads are **not electrical TENS electrodes** and are **not used to deliver electrical stimulation**.
- TENS electrodes are adhesive gel pads that connect via 2mm pin/snap leads to a TENS unit and conduct electrical current for nerve stimulation.
- Cold water therapy pads connect to tubing from a cryotherapy machine and circulate water for temperature-based therapy.

If you have a specific PMT part number or system name (for example, a particular Arctic Ice unit, Polar Vortex, or other brand), I can narrow down exactly which PMT water therapy pad and coupling converter combination would fit that setup.

payload.chatInput: Can you explain the PMT information about Ottossage - Ottoman Foot Massager?

response.answer:
The Ottossage Ottoman Foot Massager by Pain Management Technologies is a massage therapy device designed as a stylish ottoman that transforms into a powerful foot massager. It is not a TENS unit, but a multi‑mode foot massager that uses compression, rollers, vibration, and heat.

Key details:

• Product name: Ottoman Foot Massager by Ottossage  
• Product code: OTTOM  
• Category: Massage Therapy Device (not an electrical nerve stimulator/TENS)

Core features:
• Multi-function design: Functions as a regular ottoman with a lid, and as a foot massager when the lid is removed. With the lid on, you can also use the top as a vibration plate to rest and stimulate your feet.
• Massage actions:
  - Shiatsu kneading roller balls for deep tissue-style massage
  - Pneumatic air compression around the feet
  - Intense vibration
  - Optional therapeutic heat for a deeper, soothing effect
• Adjustable programs:
  - Three primary massage tool configurations:
    1) Compression with rollers
    2) Compression without rollers
    3) Vibration with rollers
  - Multiple intensity levels available for each program so you can customize the strength of the massage.
• Heat therapy:
  - Provides a heated foot massage option
  - Intended to help relieve sore muscles, support pain relief in the feet (including discomfort from plantar fasciitis), increase blood flow, reduce stress, and help expel lactic acid while you relax.

Construction & comfort:
• Washable fabric: The foot compartment covers are removable. The cloth inside the foot chambers is washable for easy cleaning and maintenance.
• Size capacity: Fits up to approximately men’s shoe size 14.

Power and operation:
• Power options:
  - Built-in li-ion rechargeable battery (upgraded, more powerful motor compared with plug-in-only models)
  - Wall adaptor for plug-in use and continual charge
• Battery life: Up to about 3 hours of use on battery power.
• Controls:
  - Top display touch button; designed to be simple and intuitive to select modes and adjust intensity.

Design notes:
• The ottoman is intended to complement living room décor while providing spa-like foot massage in the home.
• You can use it either as a normal piece of furniture (with the lid on) or as a dedicated foot massage station (with the lid off for full-foot treatment).

Warranty:
• One-year warranty is provided on the Ottoman Foot Massager.

If you’d like, tell me what kind of foot discomfort or use case you’re considering (e.g., relaxation, plantar fasciitis-related pain, general soreness), and I can highlight which Ottossage features are most relevant for that.

response.answer:
Neck Traction with Air Pump Technology by Theratrac Air is a cervical traction device designed to provide neck pain relief and help with conditions such as cervicalgia, disc degeneration, spondylosis, and spine alignment issues.

Key points you should know:

• Product purpose: It gently pulls the head away from the neck to reduce compression and alleviate pressure on the cervical spine, promoting pain relief and recovery.

• Air pump operation: The device is operated with a handheld air pump, allowing you to easily control and adjust the traction at home.

• Adjustable neck support: You can customize the width of the neck support using adjustable knobs so it can fit different neck sizes comfortably.

• Variable intensity: The stretch intensity is controlled by the pump, so you can achieve a light, comfortable, and gradual stretch rather than a sudden strong pull.

• Professional quality at home: It is designed to offer clinical‑grade cervical traction, which may reduce the need for frequent chiropractor or clinic visits for traction-type therapy.

• Portable design: The Theratrac Air is lightweight and portable, making it suitable for home use or travel so you can continue traction sessions consistently.

• Product identification: Product name – Neck Traction with Air Pump Technology by Theratrac Air; Product code – TTGAIR; Category – Traction.

This device is for cervical traction only and is not a TENS (electrical nerve stimulation) unit. It does not deliver electrical stimulation; it provides mechanical traction using air pressure.

For any questions on whether this device is appropriate for your specific medical condition or how to use cervical traction safely, please consult your healthcare professional before use.

Pain Management Technologies offers several inflatable cervical (neck) traction products, all designed to gently stretch and support the neck to help relieve muscle tension and pressure on cervical structures.

Here is a concise summary of the key inflatable/air-based neck traction options in the PMT catalog:

1) Premium Pneumatic Cervical Traction Collar (Air Neck Traction / Soft Neck Air Traction / Air Traction Devices)
- Type: Inflatable, air‑pump–driven cervical traction collar.
- Main purpose: Portable neck traction to help relax tight neck muscles and relieve pressure in joints and nerves.
- Design: Lightweight soft rubber construction with soft textile on top and bottom; thin, light, and anatomically shaped to support the neck and head.
- Operation: Uses an inflation hand pump to slowly raise pressure to a comfortable stretch; several built‑in air chambers provide gentle, even traction.
- Typical users: Office workers, people with whiplash, and those needing home/portable cervical traction.
- Key benefits (per PMT description):
  • Neck and head support
  • Gentle, even traction
  • Muscle relaxation and decompression
  • Highly portable and convenient for use on the go

2) Theratrac Cervical Traction Device (Pneumatic, sizes Small / Wide)
- Product codes: 
  • Small: PCT100‑S
  • Wide: PCT100‑W
- Type: Pneumatic cervical traction system that cradles the head and neck.
- Main purpose: To gently stretch neck muscles and help vertebral discs realign via pneumatic decompression.
- Design: Curved neck portion plus a vertically pneumatic headrest section; both regions inflate to apply traction along the cervical curve.
- Operation: Hand pumps inflate up to about 30 lbs of adjustable pneumatic pressure; easy inflate/deflate.
- Key benefits (per PMT description):
  • Gently stretches and relaxes “locked” neck muscles
  • Helps vertebral discs realign, freeing nerve root tissue from disc pressure
  • Provides pain relief, muscle relaxation, stretching, and posture improvement
  • Durable, lightweight, and portable; sized by neck circumference

3) Adjustable Inflatable Air Collar Neck Traction Device (NTD3000‑GEN‑2)
- Product code: NTD3000‑GEN‑2
- Type: Inflatable air‑collar cervical traction device with pump.
- Main purpose: On‑the‑go relief of neck muscle soreness, stiffness, and tension.
- Design: Ergonomic, memory-foam construction with removable chin pad; sits on chest and shoulders to focus stretch on the neck; soft, breathable, and skin‑friendly.
- Operation: Open via pull tab, place on shoulders, close, then use pump to elongate neck muscles.
- Key benefits (per PMT description):
  • Elongates neck muscles for rapid and sometimes prolonged relief from soreness and irritation linked to cervical problems
  • Intended for people with cervical spondylopathy, neck fatigue, and neck strain symptoms
  • Everyday use for tension from standing, sitting, or office work

Important notes:
- These items are cervical traction devices (inflatable/air or pneumatic). PMT describes them for neck traction, relaxation, and support. They are *not* described in the catalog as TENS units themselves; rather, they are traction devices used for neck support and decompression.
- PMT advises consulting a physician before using traction devices, especially if you have existing cervical spine issues or other health concerns.

If you tell me which specific inflatable neck traction model (e.g., Premium Pneumatic Cervical Traction Collar, Theratrac, or Adjustable Inflatable Air Collar NTD3000‑GEN‑2) you’re most interested in, I can give a focused, product‑specific summary with its code and core specs.

response.answer:
Pain Management Technologies (PMT) provides both standard lead wires and splitter cables for TENS and other electrotherapy devices.

1) Universal TENS Lead Wires – Premium Grade (Product Code: P-LWT)
- Category: Electrotherapy Supplies • Accessories
- Fit/Compatibility: Universal fit for most TENS and EMS units; standard 2 mm pigtail electrode/pad connectors; standard shielded plastic female right‑angle plug, FDA‑compliant.
- Construction: Premium “Tiger” lead wires, composed of 24 copper strands; about twice the thickness of standard lead wires for higher conduction and extra durability.
- Length: 48-inch wires.
- Quantity: One pair (2 leads) to connect up to 4 electrodes.
- Use/Longevity: Extra durable for long-life use. Typical lead wires last about 6–12 months for heavy users, while Tiger lead wires can last 1–2 years.
- Safety/Performance Note: Worn-out lead wires can lead to shocks or jolts; periodic replacement is recommended for optimal therapy.
- Pack: Sold in packs of two (1 pair).

2) Universal TENS Lead Wires – Standard Grade (Product Code: LWS)
- Category: Electrotherapy Supplies
- Fit/Compatibility: Universal fit; standard shielded plastic female right‑angle plug, FDA‑compliant; pins fit standard 2 mm pigtail electrode pad connectors.
- Length: 48-inch wires.
- Quantity: One pair (2 leads) to connect up to 4 electrodes.
- Construction: Standard lead wires composed of 12 copper strands, which wear out over time depending on frequency of use.
- Use/Longevity: Typical life is about 6–12 months for heavy users.
- Safety/Performance Note: Worn-out lead wires may cause shocks or jolts; they should be replaced periodically for best therapy performance.
- Pack: Sold in packs of two (1 pair).

3) Electrotherapy Splitter Cable (Product Code: SCABLE)
- Category: Electrotherapy Supplies • TENS care and accessories
- Function: Splits an electrotherapy device output from 2 leads into 4 leads by using two splitter cables.
- Use per Channel: Two splitter cables are needed per channel to effectively split and create an additional channel (e.g., to run 4 lead connections from a single 2‑lead channel).
- Key Description: Designed specifically to expand the number of leads you can run from each channel on a compatible electrotherapy device.
- Specifications: Product weight 1 lb; width 2 cm; length 1 inch; weight code G.

4) General Electrotherapy Device Lead Wires (Product Code: ET99090101)
- Category: Electrotherapy Supplies
- Function: Standard electrotherapy device lead wires.
- Connector Type: Male pin‑wire connection (long thin cylinder approximately 0.4 inches long), compatible with any electrode sold on HealioHealth.

source.question: Why does my skin turn red after treatment?
source.answer: Mild redness after using a TENS unit can be normal and is often caused by increased circulation, pressure from the electrode, or mild skin sensitivity. It should typically fade shortly after removing the pads. To reduce skin irritation: Make sure your skin is clean and dry before use. Avoid placing pads on irritated or damaged skin. Rotate pad placement between treatments. Reduce treatment intensity if the sensation feels uncomfortable. Replace electrodes when the gel becomes old or irritating.

tests.question: Would it be acceptable to use more than one channel at a time?

source.question: Can I use more than one channel at a time?
source.answer: Yes, if your TENS unit has multiple channels, you can typically use more than one channel at the time. This allows you to treat multiple areas of discomfort or use additional electrode pads for a larger treatment area. For example, one channel can be used on the lower back while another targets the hip or leg area. Always follow your device instructions and keep the intensity at a comfortable level.

tests.question: I want to know whether it safe to use a TENS unit while sleeping.

source.question: Is it safe to use a TENS unit while sleeping?
source.answer: It is generally not recommended to use a TENS unit while sleeping unless specifically instructed by a healthcare professional. While TENS is considered safe for many people, you may not notice skin irritation, discomfort, or changes in sensation while sleeping. For best results, use your TENS unit while you are awake and able to monitor the stimulation level and skin condition.
